metadata.name: python-analyzer-boundaries
metadata.description: Govern the bundled CPython AST adapter with its own Python profile.

rules.title: Python analyzer cannot launch processes
rules.remediation: Keep execution ownership in the Node runner.

rules.title: Python analyzer uses CPython AST
rules.remediation: Parse Python with the standard-library ast module.

rules.title: Python analyzer cannot dynamically execute source
rules.remediation: Inspect syntax through ast without evaluating source.

rules.title: Analysis entry point requires source
rules.remediation: Keep source as an explicit required analysis input.
